labels.name: Hair shaft
labels.function: Narrows proximally in exclamation point hairs

labels.name: Follicular opening
labels.function: Still visible in non-scarring loss; lost permanently in scarring

labels.name: Anagen
labels.function: Active growth for 2-6 years; about 85% of scalp hairs

labels.name: Hair bulb
labels.function: Swarmed by T lymphocytes in alopecia areata

labels.name: Catagen
labels.function: 2-week phase: growth stops and the follicle shrinks

labels.name: Telogen
labels.function: 3-4 month rest ending in shedding; about 15% of hairs

labels.name: Proximal nail fold
labels.function: Pushed back repetitively in habit-tic deformity

labels.name: Nail matrix
labels.function: Makes the plate; a brief halt here leaves Beau's lines

labels.name: Lovibond's angle
labels.function: Exceeds 180 degrees in clubbing

labels.name: Nail bed
labels.function: Site of splinter hemorrhages and of psoriasis or fungus

labels.name: Nail plate
labels.function: Lifts up in onycholysis; concave in iron deficiency

labels.name: Lateral nail fold
labels.function: Opened by a hangnail; abscess site in acute paronychia

diagrams.title: Common nail findings and their causes (schematic)

labels.name: Terry's nails
labels.function: Proximal 3/4 or more pale on many nails: liver disease

labels.name: Half and half nails
labels.function: Proximal half pale on many nails: renal disease

labels.name: Beau's lines
labels.function: Transverse groove on all nails after a major illness or surgery

labels.name: Splinter hemorrhages
labels.function: Linear dark streaks; in many digits, think endocarditis

labels.name: Onycholysis
labels.function: Plate lifts off the bed; one nail usually trauma, many need workup

labels.name: Subungual hematoma
labels.function: Blood under the plate; drain it if 25% or more or painful

labels.name: Clubbing
labels.function: Widened tip, angle over 180 degrees: lung cancer

labels.name: Koilonychia
labels.function: Concave spoon-shaped plate: iron deficiency anemia
